newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound gains against dlr in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound gains against dlr in quiet market.

text.p: Egyptian bankers said on Monday the pound strengthened slightly against the dollar in a quiet private-sector market as demand weakened for the U.S. currency on the last day of the government's fiscal year.
Recently, goverment-owned banks were borrowing dollars heavily to settle their accounts by June 30.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3930 pounds and 3.3960 pounds bid and at between 3.3940 pounds and 3.3980 pounds offered in the interbank market.

The average rate on Monday was 3.3943 pounds bid and 3.3964 pounds offered. On Sunday, bankers said there were hardly any pounds deals and averages on Thursday were 3.3951 pounds bid and 3.3966 pound offered.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.392298 buy and 3.397138 sell.
